tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have published weekends, with their slug, IATA airport code, currency and the twelve monthly season factors (1.0 = shoulder season; higher is dearer). Start here to discover city slugs for every other tool. Paged.

tools.name: get_city
tools.description: Fetch one city by its slug (from list_cities): name, country, region, coordinates, IATA code, currency and the twelve monthly season factors.

tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List the personas (the kind of traveller an itinerary is written for, e.g. foodie or collector) with their slug and audience: party_shapes (solo, couple, friends, family, multigen), children (boolean) and pace (relaxed, steady, brisk). Persona slugs are used with city slugs to name an itinerary. Pag

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Fetch one persona by its slug (from list_personas), with its audience.

tools.name: list_origins
tools.description: List the origins a trip can start from: slug (pass as origin to the pricing and booking tools), name and IATA airport code. Unpaged.

tools.name: list_pricing_tiers
tools.description: List the budget tiers in display order (cheap, modest, expensive, luxury, ultra). Pass the name as tier.

tools.name: list_pricing_multipliers
tools.description: List every price multiplier: for each (tier, dimension) the factor applied to the modest-tier price. Dimensions are sight, culture, dining, lodging, transport and flight.

tools.name: list_published_itineraries
tools.description: The public index: every published itinerary with its city and persona slugs, title, summary, names, step counts and the sum of its steps' costs in integer cents (currency EUR unless the city says otherwise). Use it to discover which (city, persona) weekends exist.

tools.name: get_published_itinerary
tools.description: The full published itinerary for one (city, persona): its days and steps with local times (HH:MM), kind, notes, cost_cents per person at the modest tier (integer cents), reserve_days (how many days ahead a hard step must be booked, or null), a fallback, and each step's venue with coordinates and off

tools.name: itinerary_calendar
tools.description: The published itinerary as iCalendar text for one weekend (Friday = day 0): one event per step at floating local times, no time zone. friday is a YYYY-MM-DD date.

tools.name: estimate_itinerary
tools.description: Budget estimate (integer cents) for a published itinerary: activities, lodging, transport and flights for a tier, a month or the year average, and a group.

tools.name: estimate_all
tools.description: Every published itinerary priced at once (integer cents): total, per person and flights per (city, persona), plus the cheapest persona per city, for a tier, a month or the year average, a group and an optional origin; each estimate carries the persona's party_shapes. Estimates only, no fare lookups;

tools.name: get_fare
tools.description: Cheapest known return fare per person between two IATA codes for a Friday-to-Monday weekend (cached from Travelpayouts).

tools.name: booking_checklist
tools.description: Booking links and checklist for a weekend, ordered by scarcity: first the steps that must be booked ahead (longest lead time first, each with reserve_days, a book_by date YYYY-MM-DD and an easier fallback), then flights, the hotel and the other bookable steps. tools.name: booking_manifest
tools.description: Everything an agent needs to book one weekend, in the order to book it. Returns items (flights, hotel and bookable steps; scarcest first) each with kind, title, when (date YYYY-MM-DD and local time HH:MM), the affiliate-tracked partner url with dates, party size and time prefilled where the partner

tools.name: submit_tip
tools.description: Send a tip about a city: a place to add, a closed place, somewhere nearly impossible to book, or a wrong fact. Public. A tip is never published; an editor reviews it first. Rate limited per sender.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "booking_manifest" is 936 chars, far longer than this server's median (184). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Everything an agent needs to book one weekend, in the order to book it. Returns items (flights, hotel and bookable steps; scarcest first) each with kind, title,…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: booking_checklist, booking_manifest · Private data: booking_manifest · Public sink: submit_tip · Destructive: booking_checklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: booking_checklist, booking_manifest · Private data: booking_manifest · Public sink: submit_tip · Destructive: booking_checklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
